verses.eng: "And that mystery knows wherefor the twelve orders of the Unspeakables have rent themselves asunder and wherefor they have
divided themselves, being three portions, and wherefor they have come forth from the Fatherless.

"And that mystery knows wherefor all the Imperishables, being their twelve orders, have rent themselves asunder and wherefor they have settled themselves, being expanded in a single order, and wherefor they have divided themselves and formed different orders, being uncontainable and boundless, and wherefor they have come forth from the Fatherless.

"And that mystery knows wherefor the Impassables have rent themselves asunder and wherefor they have set themselves up, being twelve boundless spaces, and have settled themselves, being three orders of spaces, according to the economy of the One and Only, the Ineffable, and wherefor they have come forth from the Fatherless.

"And that mystery knows wherefor the twelve Uncontainables, which belong to the orders of the One and Only, the Ineffable, have rent themselves asunder and wherefor they have come forth from the Fatherless, until they were brought to the space of the First Mystery, which is the second space.

"And that mystery knows wherefor the four-and-twenty myriads of Praise-singers have rent themselves asunder and wherefor they have extended themselves outside the veil of the First Mystery, which is the twin-mystery, that which looks within and without, of the One and Only, the Ineffable, and wherefor they have come forth from the Fatherless.
"And that mystery knows wherefor all the

Uncontainables have rent themselves asunder--[those], which I have just named, which are in the regions of the second space of the Ineffable, which is the space of the First Mystery, and wherefor those Uncontainables and Boundless have come forth from the Fatherless.

Of those of the first space of the Ineffable. "And that mystery knows wherefor the four-and-twenty mysteries of the first Thrice-spiritual have rent themselves asunder and wherefor they are called the four-and-twenty spaces of the first Thrice-spiritual and wherefor they have come forth from the second Thrice-spiritual.
"And that mystery knows wherefor the four-and-twenty mysteries of the second Thrice-spiritual have rent themselves asunder and wherefor they have come forth from the third Thrice-spiritual.

"And that mystery knows why the four-and-twenty mysteries of the third Thrice-spiritual--that is the four-and-twenty spaces of the third Thrice-spiritual--have rent themselves asunder and wherefor they have come forth from the Fatherless.

"And that mystery knows wherefor the five Trees of the first Thrice-spiritual have rent themselves asunder and wherefor they have extended themselves, standing one behind the other and moreover bound one to the other with all their orders, and wherefor they have come forth from the Fatherless.
"And that mystery knows wherefor the five Trees of the second Thrice-spiritual have rent themselves asunder and wherefor they have come forth from the Fatherless.
"And that mystery knows wherefor the five Trees of the third Thrice-spiritual have rent themselves asunder and wherefor they have come forth from the Fatherless.
"And that mystery knows why the Fore-uncontainables of the first Thrice-spiritual have rent themselves asunder and wherefor they have come forth from the Fatherless.
"And that mystery knows wherefor the Fore-uncontainables of the second Trispiritual have rent themselves asunder and wherefor they have come forth from the Fatherless.
"And that mystery knows wherefor all the Fore-uncontainables of the third Thrice-spiritual have rent themselves asunder and wherefor they have come forth from the Fatherless.

"And that mystery knows wherefor the first Thrice-spiritual from below--those who belong to the orders of the One and Only, the Ineffable has rent itself asunder and wherefor it has come forth from the second Thrice-spiritual.

"And that mystery knows wherefor the third Thrice-spiritual--that is the first Thrice-spiritual from above--has rent itself asunder and wherefor it has come forth from the twelfth Pro-thrice-spiritual, which is in the last region of the Fatherless.

"And that mystery knows wherefor all the regions which are in the space of the Ineffable, and all those in them, have expanded themselves, and wherefor they have come forth from the last Limb of the Ineffable.
"And that mystery knows itself, wherefor it has rent itself asunder to come forth from the Ineffable,--that is from That which rules them
all and which expanded them all according to their orders.

Jesus promises to explain further all in detail. "Of all these then will I speak to you at the expansion of the universe--in a word, all those whom I have spoken of to you: those who will arise and those who will come, those who emanate, and those who come forth, and those who are without over them, and those who are implanted in them, those who will contain the region of the First Mystery and those who are in the space of the Ineffable--of these will I speak to you, because I will reveal them to you, and I will speak of them to you according to every region and according to every order, at the expansion of the universe. And I will reveal to you all their mysteries which rule over them all, and their Pro-thrice-spirituals and their Super-thrice-spirituals which rule over their mysteries and their orders.

Of the mystery succinctly. "Now, therefore, the mystery of the Ineffable knows wherefor all these have arisen of whom I have spoken to you in openness, and through which all these have arisen. It is the mystery which is in them all; and it is the out-going of them all, and it is the up-going of them all, and it is the setting-up of them all.

"And the mystery of the Ineffable is the mystery which is in all these of whom I have spoken to you, and of whom I will speak to you at the expansion of the universe. And it is the mystery which is in them all, and it is the one only mystery of the Ineffable and the gnosis of all these of whom I have spoken to you, and of whom I will speak to you, and of whom I have not spoken. Of these will I speak to
you at the expansion of the universe and of their total gnosis one with another, wherefor they have arisen. It is the one and only word of the Ineffable.

"And I will tell you the expansion of all mysteries and the types of every one of them and the manner of their completion in all their figures. And I will tell you the mystery of the One and Only, the Ineffable, and all its types, all its figures and its whole economy, wherefor it has come forth from the last Limb of the Ineffable. For that mystery is the setting-up of them all.

Of the one and only word of the Ineffable. "And that mystery of the Ineffable is moreover also an one and only word, which exists in the speech of the Ineffable, and it is the economy of the solution of all the words which I have spoken to you.

"And he who will receive the one and only word of that mystery which I shall now say to you, and all its types and all its figures, and the manner of accomplishing its mystery,--for you are perfect and all-perfect and you will accomplish the whole gnosis of that mystery with its whole economy, for to you all mysteries are entrusted,--hearken, therefore, now, that I may tell you that mystery, which is [...?].

Of the ascension of the soul of him who shall receive the one and only mystery. "He then, who shall receive the one and only word of that mystery, which I have told you, if he comes forth out of the body of the matters of the rulers, and if the retributive receivers come and free him from the body of matter of the rulers,--that is those [receivers] who free from the body all out-going souls,--when, therefore, the retributive receivers free the soul which

has received this one and only mystery of the Ineffable, which I have just told you, then will it straightway, if it be set free from the body of matter, become a great light-stream in the midst of those receivers, and the receivers will be exceedingly afraid of the light of that soul, and the receivers will be made powerless and fall down and desist altogether for fear of the great light which they have seen.

"And the soul which receives the mystery of the Ineffable, will soar into the height, being a great light-stream, and the receivers will not be able to seize it and will not know how the way is fashioned upon which it will go. For it becomes a great light-stream and soars into the height, and no power is able to hold it down at all, nor will they be able to come nigh it at all.

"But it will pass through all the regions of the rulers and all the regions of the emanations of the Light, and it will not give answers in any region, nor gives it any apologies, nor gives it any tokens; neither will any power of the rulers nor any power of the emanations of the Light be able to come nigh that soul. But all the regions of the rulers and all the regions of the emanations of the Light,--every one sings to it praises in their regions, in fear of the light of the stream which envelops that soul, until it passes through them all, and goes to the region of the inheritance of the mystery which it has received,--that is to the mystery of the One and Only, the Ineffable,--and until it becomes one with its Limbs. Aman, I say to you: It will be in all the regions in the time an man shoots an arrow.

Of the rank of such a soul. "Now, therefore, amen, I say to you: Every man who will receive that mystery of the Ineffable and accomplish it in all its types and all its figures,--he is an man in the world, but he towers above all angels and will tower still more above them all.
"He is an man in the world, but he towers above all archangels and will tower still more above them all.
"He is an man in the world, but he towers above all tyrants and will raise himself above them all.
"He is an man in the world, but he towers above all lords and will raise himself above them all.
"He is an man in the world, but he towers above all gods and will raise himself above them all.
"He is an man in the world, but he towers above all light-givers and will raise himself above them all.
"He is an man in the world, but he towers above all pure ones] and will raise himself above them all.
